interpretationPrinciple: Preserve the TCG Live section's proved visual hierarchy, responsive reordering, layered asset identities, and entry choreography at section-local scope. Do not promote its red/gold seam, honeycomb field, black panel, white CTA, or motion into site-wide tokens or generic recipes.

visualIntent.summary: A product-world callout that moves from a branded red/gold threshold into a restrained light-gray technical field. A layered device-and-character scene demonstrates the product visually, while a black copy panel creates a decisive, readable endpoint.
hierarchy: The red/gold chevron is an entry seam embedded in the section background, not the dominant section fill.
The pale gray honeycomb field supports the product composition without competing with it.
The five-layer product scene carries recognition before the copy on mobile and alongside it on desktop.
The black panel groups heading, body, and CTA as one local callout, not as a generic site surface.
The hard lower boundary hands off directly to the pale-blue Pocket section.
brandSignals: red/gold V-shaped top threshold over a pale gray honeycomb field
five independently layered transparent product assets
Kanit heavy display heading paired with PT Sans body and CTA
white rectangular CTA with black-to-gold foreground hover
viewport-entry pop for the laptop and staggered slide/fade for copy and companion assets

layers.rule: Use the independently loaded TCG Live background raster as one full-bleed field: red/gold chevron at the top, pale gray honeycomb through the body, and no inferred background motion.
Desktop places a translucent-black rectangular panel on the left; mobile places an opaque-black full-width panel below the asset composition.
Keep laptop as the large rear plane; Pikachu at lower left, phone at lower right, and two avatar hexagons floating above. Preserve five independent image identities and overlaps.
Use exactly the proved visible hierarchy: centered H2, one centered paragraph, and one centered white CTA. Do not add a kicker.
End with a hard boundary into the following pale-blue section; do not wrap this callout in a floating card or rounded shell.

desktop: left copy panel: heading, paragraph, CTA
right layered scene: laptop, Pikachu, phone, avatars
mobile: layered scene: avatars, laptop, Pikachu, phone
full-width black panel: heading, paragraph, CTA

interactionRecipes.trigger: section entering the viewport through normal incremental scrolling
rules: Laptop changes from opacity 0 and scale .5 to opacity 1 and scale 1.
Heading changes from opacity 0 and translateY 15.398px to its settled position.
Paragraph and CTA use the same slide/fade family with staggered delays and their evidenced initial translate values.
Pikachu, phone, and avatars participate as staggered companion layers.
acceptance: Capture before-entry, intermediate, and settled visual states.
The laptop scale change and copy opacity/translation must be visibly observable, not only represented by classes.
The final layered composition must settle at opacity 1 without losing overlap relationships.
Do not convert the entry effect into continuous scroll-linked motion.

interactionRecipes.scope: TCG Live Learn More CTA only
interactionRecipes.rule: Keep the white background unchanged while changing the label/icon foreground from black to gold on pointer hover.

interactionRecipes.scope: TCG Live Learn More CTA only
interactionRecipes.rule: Activate navigation to the TCG Live overview destination; a visual-only inert button is not equivalent.

mustPreserve: tcgl-background raster identity including red/gold top seam and gray honeycomb body
laptop as the large rear plane
Pikachu overlapping the lower-left laptop edge
phone overlapping the lower-right laptop edge
two avatar hexagons floating above the laptop
five independent transparent assets rather than one flattened screenshot
desktop copy-left/assets-right and mobile assets-first/copy-second ordering
allowedVariation: The complete group may scale proportionally to fit the available width.
Small positional translation is allowed only to preserve the evidenced overlap and visual balance across widths.
English text may wrap naturally at the available width without hard-coded breaks.
mustNotReplace: Do not use a screenshot crop or flattened composite as runtime artwork.
Do not substitute unrelated device, character, or avatar assets.
Do not turn the red/gold top seam into a solid-red section.
Do not retain the desktop side-by-side order on mobile.
Do not add a kicker, rounded outer shell, or animated background.

sectionLocalRules: translucent-black desktop copy panel and opaque-black mobile copy panel
Kanit heading and PT Sans copy/CTA roles
white CTA with black-to-gold foreground hover
laptop pop plus staggered copy/asset entry
notGlobalTokens: Red is not inferred as the global page background, primary action, or interaction emphasis.
Gold is not inferred as a global active or primary color; it is proved only for the seam asset and this CTA hover foreground.
Black panel styling is not inferred for all sections, cards, modals, or host surfaces.
The honeycomb texture is not inferred as a global page background.
Kanit and PT Sans roles here do not create unrestricted global typography tokens.
The entry motion is not a global animation recipe and does not authorize background motion.

unresolvedClaims.impact: The translated screenshot cannot prescribe original-English line breaks or exact copy height.
unresolvedClaims.downstreamRule: Use the recorded English DOM/computed typography and fluid layout; do not hard-code wrapping from the Chinese capture.
Implement the background as static and do not claim learned background motion.

requirementsForDesignDirection: Freeze all six source asset identities and the five foreground-layer relationships.
Require an active CTA destination and hover foreground change.
Reject solid-red fields, invented kickers, flattened screenshots, translated hard breaks, and background animation.
